Getting ready for your interview? Not so sure of how you’re going to answer the interview questions? Have no flying experience? No worries, I’ve got YOU!
Here’s a sample Cabin Crew Question & Answer sample especially made for you!


Flight Attendant Interview Questions | WHY DO YOU WANT TO BE A FLIGHT ATTENDANT?

One of the top questions I received. How will I answer the question? How to answer the question? Here's the vlog where I answer this question.

#FlightAttendantInterviewQuestions #WhyDoYouWantToBeAFlightAttendant #Misskaykrizz


Sample answer:
“I always wanted to become a flight attendant ever since my first experience of flight as a kid. I remember my first flight and it has made such an impression for me that I have always aspired to become a part of the flight attendant team. Even though I very much enjoyed my current job, I am now looking for a job that is hands-on, challenging, spontaneous, and something that would help me grow as an individual. And I really think that I have the qualities that is needed in the role of a flight attendant. I really love working with people. If you let me choose between working in front of the computer or working with people, I would definitely work with people.  I love it when every one is working towards the same goal, achieving the same thing, and afterwards celebrating together as well. So, aside from that I understand and I know that the excellent service is the bread and butter of the airline industry because every airline can offer the same thing or lower price but if you offer them the best service that will make an impression with them that is when I was a child, they will come back, and be loyal to your airline. And I am very much ready to become a part of that them that would make it happen. To make that excellent service happen for your company. Given the chance, I’m here and  I’m ready to take on the challenge of being a flight attendant. Thank you.”
